data.name: C4 Original x JOLLY RANCHER
data.description:
Hard candy flavor just hits harder. Get ready to unwrap C4 Original x JOLLY RANCHER — now available in Green Apple!

Every scoop is packed with 200mg of caffeine and 2g of CarnoSyn® Beta-Alanine to fuel explosive workouts and fight muscular fatigue.^ The triple threat blend of L-Citrulline, L-Arginine, and NO3-T® Creatine Nitrate works to support increased nitric oxide production for serious power and pumps. With caffeine, Huperzine-A and AI-powered PeptiPump®, C4 Original x JOLLY RANCHER delivers enhanced focus and performance for harder-hitting results.*

KEY FEATURES

    HARD-HITTING ENERGY™: Power explosive training sessions with 200mg caffeine.*
    ICONIC CANDY FLAVOR: Electrify your senses with a jolt of JOLLY RANCHER Green Apple.
    MUSCULAR ENDURANCE: Combat muscular fatigue with clinically studied CarnoSyn® Beta-Alanine.^*
    POWERFUL PUMPS: Experience serious pumps with Velox® and AI-powered PeptiPump®, exclusive to C4.*
    ENHANCED FOCUS: Support mind-muscle connection with caffeine + Huperzine-A.*
    C4: Backed by 20 years of sports nutrition expertise, we’ve raised the bar with an innovative selection of supplements.

INGREDIENTS

    200mg Caffeine: Hard Hitting Energy™ + enhanced focus.*
    Velox® Performance Blend: A patented combination of L-Citrulline and L-Arginine designed to support performance, pump, and recovery.*
    Creatine Nitrate ( NO3-T®): Supports increased pump and training performance.*
    CarnoSyn® Beta-Alanine: Clinically studied ingredient that helps support muscular endurance and combat muscular fatigue.^*
    PeptiPump® Bioactive Lentil Peptides: Used in combination with VELOX® Performance Blend and Creatine Nitrate to support increased pump and training performance.*
    Huperzine A: In conjunction with caffeine, supports enhanced focus.*

^Studies have shown benefits of CarnoSyn® Beta-Alanine to be correlated with cumulative use.
Take one serving (1 scoop) of C4 Sport®, mixed with 6-8 fl. oz. of water 20 - 30 minutes before training. During your workout, it is recommended that you drink plenty of water. Some individuals may experience a harmless tingling sensation, which is attributed to beta alanine.
THIS PRODUCT IS ONLY INTENDED TO BE CONSUMED BY HEALTHY ADULTS, 18 YEARS OF AGE OR OLDER. Do not use this product if you are pregnant, nursing, or are currently taking nitrates for chest pain or if you are taking medication used to treat erectile dysfunction such as PDE-5 inhibitors. Before using this product, consult a licensed, qualified, health care professional, including but not limited to, if: you are taking antidepressants such as a MAOI (Monoamine Oxidase Inhibitor) or SSRI, blood thinners, nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs, pseudoephedrine, or you are taking any other dietary supplement, prescription drug or over-the-counter medication; or if, you suspect you have or have been treated for, diagnosed with or have a family history of, any medical condition, including but not limited to: high or low blood pressure, diabetes, glaucoma, anxiety, cardiovascular, psychiatric or seizure disorders, cardiac arrhythmia, stroke, heart, liver, kidney or thyroid disease, or difficulty urinating due to prostate enlargement. This product contains caffeine and should not be used by individuals wishing to eliminate caffeine from their diet or in combination with caffeine or stimulants from other sources, including but not limited to, coffee, tea, soda, or other dietary supplements and medications. Discontinue use 2 weeks prior to surgery. Immediately discontinue use and contact a medical doctor if you experience any adverse reaction to this product. Do not use if safety seal is broken or missing. Store in a cool dry place. KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN.

data.name: C4 Ultimate® Strength Pre Workout Powder
data.description:

Next, 3.2g of fatigue-fighting CarnoSyn® Beta-Alanine + 1.25g of BetaPower® work to turn your endurance up a notch.^ And the powerhouse combination of 5.5g quality creatine compounds, 2.4g of AI-Powered PeptiStrong®, and 150mg of ElevATP® enhance strength, power, and muscle mass. Finally, with 200mg of AI-powered PeptiPump®, a C4 Exclusive, plus a patented VELOX® blend of L-Citrulline and L-Arginine, you'll experience seriously satisfying pumps and performance.*

Make your training pop with the new C4 Ultimate Strength x POPSICLE® pre-workout!

    UNRIVALLED PUMPS: Made with VELOX®: a patented mix of L-Arginine + L-Citrulline for seriously satisfying pumps & performance.*
    ULTIMATE MUSCLE ENDURANCE^: Keep each rep hitting as hard as your first with fatigue fighting CarnoSyn® Beta-Alanine + BetaPower ®.*
    AI-POWERED PEPTIDES: PeptiPump® and PeptiStrong ® are AI-powered designer peptides exclusively found in C4.
    ENHANCED MENTAL FOCUS: Get the focus boost needed to HIT HARDER with support from Tyrosine + Huperzine A + Caffeine.*
    C4: Backed by 20 years of sports nutrition expertise, we’ve raised the bar with an innovative selection of supplements.

INGREDIENTS

    300mg Caffeine: Ultimate energy + enhanced focus.*
    Dynamine™: Compliments Caffeine to help support increased energy.*
    TeaCrine®: Supports increased energy, mood, and focus when in combination with Caffeine.*

    Creatine Monohydrate: Supports increased strength, power, and muscle mass.*

    ElevATP®: Supports increased strength, power, and muscle mass.*
